observations: A black motorcycle partially covered in white bubble wrap and clear protective plastic.
The text 'RY200-38' is clearly visible on the side panel in photo 0.
The motorcycle features a front disc brake and black multi-spoke alloy wheels.
The seat is covered in a clear plastic sheet.
The handlebars, mirrors, and front forks are wrapped in bubble wrap.
The bike is parked in an outdoor, unpaved area with people and other items in the background.

claims.evidence: The presence of protective wrapping is consistent with a new item but does not prove the mechanical age or that it hasn't been refurbished.
The 'RY' prefix in the model number 'RY200-38' on the side panel in photo 0 is the standard designation for Royal brand motorcycles in this market.
The '200' in the model number 'RY200-38' in photo 0 typically denotes the engine displacement.
The visible bodywork on the tank and side panels in photo 0 is black.

risks.risk: The engine may not start or may have internal defects.
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine starting from cold and idling.

risks.risk: The motorcycle may be used or have high mileage despite the wrapping.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the odometer showing the total mileage.

risks.risk: The motorcycle may lack legal ownership or customs clearance documentation.
risks.proof: Photos of the customs clearance papers or vehicle registration documents.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running.
Photos of the customs clearance or registration documents.
Photos of the motorcycle with all protective wrapping removed to inspect for hidden damage.
response.reason: The model RY200-38 is clearly identified from the photo. It can be priced at its worst-case scenario (used, non-functional, and without papers) until the seller provides proof of its condition and legal status.
